prompt:
A photographic LIVE-ACTION home video through ONE real adult Taiwanese father's eye-mounted camera. Exactly 30 seconds. All movement in real time, one continuous take, no edits, cutaways, jump cuts, shot/reverse-shot or external view of the father. Urgent messy multitasking in a modest apartment, not cinematic coverage. No captions, music or narration.

VIDEO 1 is a WHITE UNTEXTURED GEOMETRY AND MOTION ANIMATIC. Follow its EXACT room topology, camera translation/rotation, timing, object placements and interaction sequence. White people/hands are only untextured pose references. Completely synthesize real human anatomy, living skin, natural fingers, hair and cloth. NEVER copy dummy facial design, spherical doll heads, rigid limbs, robot joints, white material or clay appearance. Render every frame photographically. Never turn into a game render.

IMAGE 1 is the photographic kitchen appearance reference. Preserve the pan, rightward black handle, cooktop, window, pale counter, sage lower cabinets, white spoon rest to the right and diagonal wooden spoon. It defines identities/materials and their resting locations, not an instruction to override timed actions. During stirring the ONE spoon leaves its rest and is in the hand; never duplicate it. Return it to that same rest. One silver fridge beside the kitchen. Blue two-seat fabric sofa, teal rug, oak coffee table, ONE black smartphone, closed oak door. Matte light beige tile floor, cream walls and brown skirting. Do not invent cabinets, other furniture, appliances or room openings. Layout never changes while offscreen.

One new fictional real-looking East Asian boy aged about four: short straight black bowl-cut hair, round natural face, dark brown eyes, plain mustard-yellow cotton short-sleeved tee, navy soft trousers, bare feet. He remains seated on the rug beside the blue sofa. Natural small body movements and expressive face, no toy-like body or glossy plastic skin. ONE plain red rubber ball, not a lattice ball. He is safe, mildly upset and demanding attention. The camera wearer is an adult father with real bare forearms, natural hands with five fingers and rolled-up dark cotton sleeves; never show him from outside.

PERFORMANCE: the father is genuinely pressed for time, breathing audibly, speaking quickly in short interrupted bursts, raising his voice toward the door and the child while doing things. Do not deliver soothing, slow or neutral narration. Natural Taiwanese Mandarin. A separate adult caller has telephone speaker coloration and a distinct voice. Child, phone, doorbell and simmering may overlap and continue offscreen. Spatial audio reflects their fixed locations. Child is never hurt, no fire or accident. No automatic cinematic slow motion.

Preserve all props through looking away and return. No automatic relocation, disappearance, duplication or shape substitution. A lift visibly removes the same object from its support; putting it down restores it there. Follow the guide's gesture mechanics with real anatomy, not white material. Feet walking and body bending give coherent perspective and parallax. No hidden cut during a fast pan.

GLOBAL SECONDS 0–30:
0–3.4: Already looking down into the saucepan; real right hand stirs warm milk with ONE wooden spoon. Gentle bubbling. Child fusses offscreen. Father, fast and distracted: 「等一下，爸爸在煮牛奶！」
3.4–5: Put spoon on the original white rest at the right. It remains there for the entire rest of this segment. Child's red ball rolls a short distance away as in the guide.
5–9.5: Child calls 「爸爸！球跑掉了！」 Father turns, walks briskly toward the rug and bends. Keep that same kitchen behind him, continuing to heat.
9.5–15.5: Bend, grasp the ball, lift it and hand the SAME red ball back to the child, following the guide. Child remains beside sofa. Father: 「好，拿好！不要再丟了！」
16–19: The phone on the coffee table starts ringing while child still fusses. Rise and look down toward the ringing phone, reach as the guide shows.
19–24.2: Lift the phone upright, tap to answer on speaker; the phone is absent from the table while held. Caller, from speaker: 「我已經到樓下了，你好了沒？」 Father urgently: 「還沒！小孩在哭，爐子還開著！」 Return it to its EXACT original coffee-table position by 24.2s, keeping the speakerphone call active.
26: Doorbell rings twice over the ongoing call and simmering. Father turns and walks quickly toward the CLOSED entrance door, calling louder: 「來了！你等一下！」
27–30: Approach the door without opening it. End at the guide's door-facing eye position, before the next reach. No cut or closing title. Do not resolve the cooking problem yet. Phone remains on coffee table, spoon on rest, stove still on, child seated with red ball.

The guide now has anatomical five-finger hands. Preserve their hand/palm orientation and physical contact with objects while synthesizing natural skin and clothing. Phone rests against PALM, fingers grip the edges, never attach it to the back of the hand. Natural nails, no black cylindrical fingertips. Continuous visible bending and reaching; no floating props.
